name: @kickside/agent-onboarding-ui
title: First agent onboarding
description: Create a first personal agent with optional installed capabilities.

wippy.description: First-agent creation for authenticated users who own no agent. Mount as a user-scoped splash step. The component uses the shared capability and model pickers, and creates through the canonical agents API. It emits navigate with {path, startToken} after creation and done with {status: skipped} on dismissal; the host persists completion before navigation.
